summary: Advancing medical AI for inclusive healthcare requires evaluation across diverse healthcare roles, tasks, and care settings, but benchmark coverage remains uneven. We introduce InclusionMed, an open medical AI evaluation initiative for inclusive healthcare.
takeaways: For the first release, we selected four public benchmarks from 388 candidates through structured audits and independent reproduction.
A within-benchmark analysis using task-level tags showed that the ten highest-ranked models in the Index all scored higher on patient communication than on clinical decision-making.
These findings highlight the need for evaluation covering more diverse healthcare needs and for context-specific model selection.
